en.html:
After due consideration, Ichizo Sorimachi concluded that he had been, on the whole, rather lucky. He reached this conclusion lying on a futon as thin as a papad, with his poor body aching in every department.

Failing to get away from that policeman, rolling down a slope and landing in an autumn river, which was not even warm: yes, that was bad luck, he would admit. But to be picked up and treated before he froze to death? For a man like him, that was a rare windfall.

And so he was alive. Alive means lucky. A man cannot argue with the result, so lucky it was.

If there was any worry, it was the chance of that policeman, or that inspector, barging in here. Even then, Sorimachi, a man of the trade, reckoned it would work out somehow.

After all, there were two helpless children in this house. Grab even one of them as a hostage before he was pinned down, and a way out would open.

Thinking this gave him no pain at all. Sadistic pleasure, no, that he did not feel either. Although, if it meant putting one over on that policeman or the GHQ woman... well. Then, perhaps.

That was Ichizo Sorimachi. A small man with a small nature, who had lived small and low, and was content with that.

All his interest went to hurting people, trapping them, and picking up small profits that way. His brains worked only in that direction. Chivalry, gratitude, loyalty, filial duty, all these high-class things he had never been able to understand. To him they meant nothing.

Then what to do, he thought. He understood only small things, so he lived small. Fine living could be left to those who understood fine things.

So he did not hesitate. Thinking of harming the girls who had saved him would not trouble him. Nor would putting such a thought into practice. With his usual thin smile on, Sorimachi could do it.

His meanness was the real, forged-through article. Even with his mind fogged by the pain of the bruises, he kept working through such plans, and when he heard the door open, he turned to the next room to prepare. A different class of low, this man.

He made himself unnoticeable (being half out of his senses just now made it perfect, he thought, foolishly, for a moment), held his breath, and moved his head to the gap in the paper door between this room and the next.

And he looked at what lay beyond.

ja.html:
雪車町一蔵は結論として、自分はまあそこそこ幸運
だったと、そう思うことにした。
　痛む体を、煎餅布団に横たえながら。

　あの<ruby>警官<rt>おまわり</rt></ruby>から逃げ損ね、斜面を転げ落ち秋の温かく
もない川に没する羽目になったのは不運としても。
　凍死する前に拾われ手当てを受けられたのは、自分
のような人間にとっては稀有の奇貨。

　そうして結果的に、自分は生き延びている。
　ならやはり、幸運だったと言わねばならないだろう。

　懸念があるとすれば、ここにあの警官や、あの巡察
官などが踏み込んできた場合のことだが……
　その場合も何とかなるだろうと、筋者雪車町一蔵は
踏んでいる。

　何しろこの家には無力な子供が二人もいるのだ。
　取り押さえられる前にその片方でも人質にできれば、
活路は開ける。

　……こう考える時、雪車町という男の精神上に別段、
苦痛は存在しない。
　嗜虐的な喜びを覚えることもないが――いや。あの
警官やＧＨＱの女に一泡吹かせられるのなら。

　雪車町一蔵とはそういう男だ。
　卑小な人格を持ち、卑劣に生きてきた。
　それで良いと思っている。

　人を傷つけ、陥れて、小利を稼ぐことにのみ、興味
関心が向いた。そういうことにだけ知恵が回った。
　義侠だの、恩義だの、忠孝だの、そういった上等な
ものはどうしても理解できなかった。無意味だった。

　なら仕方ない、と雪車町一蔵は思うのだ。
　自分には卑小なことしかわからない。だから卑小に
生きる。
　上等な人生は、上等なことのわかる奴がやればいい。

　だから彼は躊躇わない。
　自分を助けた少女達に災いなす考えを弄ぶことにも、
そして、それを実行することにも。
　いつもの薄笑いを浮かべたまま、雪車町はやれる。

　その卑劣さは筋金入りだ。
　打撲の痛みに意識を朦朧とさせながらも、彼はその
ような考えを巡らし、戸口が開く音を聞き取った時に
は、行動に備えて隣の様子を窺った。卑劣さが違う。

　気配を殺し――今は意識が飛んでるから完璧だなど
と彼は愚昧なことをちらと考えた――息を殺し、この
部屋と隣室を隔てる障子戸の隙間へ、頭を運ぶ。
　そして、その向こうの光景を見た。

en.html:
Kageaki"...Crying?"
Kageaki"What does it mean, to cry?"
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"That I should say, what a pitiful thing I have done? That I did it unwillingly? That I never wanted to do any of this? That I should shed tears and prove that my nature is good at the root?"
Kageaki"Is that what you want me to say?"
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"...Do not mock me, Muramasa."
Kageaki"If a man is truly good, he does not kill people to begin with! Tears shed after the killing are nothing but the ugliest hypocrisy!"
Kageaki"Killing is an evil act, and one who commits evil is a demon. I am a demon!"
Kageaki"I AM A DEMON!!"
Muramasa《...I will say again what I said before.》
Muramasa《You need not think.》
Muramasa《You are only my hands and feet. Muramasa's hands and feet.》
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa《Hands and feet have no need to think. Just let yourself be used.》
Muramasa《When everything is over, I will set you free. Until then, keep your heart closed.》
Muramasa《Think nothing, feel nothing... and wait for that time.》
Kageaki"...Is the sermon finished? Armor."
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"If you say you are my master, I will ask you one thing. Why?"
Kageaki"WHY?"
Muramasa《...I remember being asked this before.》
Muramasa《My answer is what it was. I am a weapon. I only fulfill the principle that shaped me.》
Kageaki"Principle..."
Muramasa《Meet a demon, cut the demon. Meet a Buddha, cut the Buddha.》
Muramasa《I have no other reason. I am not human.》
Muramasa《I am an armor.》
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa《If even closing your heart is too painful, then hate me, wholly. You have the standing for it.》
Muramasa《You have the right to hate, from the bottom of your heart, the blade that cursed your life.》
Kageaki"I have no such right."
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"You said you are only a weapon, armor. Exactly so."
Kageaki"You are only a weapon. Only a tool. A tool has no sin. A tool cannot carry sin."
Kageaki"The duty of using a tool, the right, the responsibility, the guilt: all of it belongs to me alone. You have none of it. Naturally. There is no master who pushes responsibility onto his slave."
Muramasa《...Mido.》
Kageaki"Sin belongs to the one who uses the tool. Then the one to be hated is that person alone."

　蝦夷の一家が死に、
　そして、村も死に絶えた。

　何も、残らなかった。

　何も。
　何も。
　何一つ。

　全てがここに、灰燼へ帰す。
